blocks.text: Rowan Bell · Community Manager · call with Glinda Southwell · February 4, 2026
Glinda closed out the South Meadow room dispute between the study group and the music society.
She says she didn't propose anything. “I asked each side what they'd be willing to do themselves, and the schedule they wrote is better than anything I'd have offered.”
The agreement has held since the autumn. She'd be glad to talk about mediation at a members' evening. Not scheduled yet; I said I'd look for a date in the spring.
